title: Chapter 443: Rag Personally Attacks The Great Wall
content:
Chapter 443: Rag Personally Attacks The Great Wall

The only thing left was the Great Sophora Domain.

Rag had broken through two cities in a row, and he was a little inflated.

He thought that the Great Sophora Domain was just like that. After all, the Great Sophora Domain was a young force compared to these two groups of forces.

So he ordered half of the demon soldiers to continue attacking the remaining cities.

He took the other half of the demon soldiers to the Great Wall of the Great Sophora Domain.

At this time, Wang Shuo was inspecting the injured soldiers.

Under the treatment of the doctors in the Great Sophora Domain, those who survived were basically out of danger.

After all, as long as they did not die on the spot, they could basically save their lives with the diluted water of life.

As for those who were missing arms and legs, there was no way, and they had to be sent to the rear for retirement.

At this time, Wang Shuo received news from the spies.

He learned that Sunset City and Qingyang City were successively broken.

The demon king Rag was on his way.

Wang Shuo's heart trembled, but his face did not change. He told them to protect themselves and went directly back to the city wall.

Ayub was deploying defenses and arranging soldiers to guard the city.

Wang Shuo told Ayub about the coming of the demon king.

"Lord, I'm afraid we can't hold this battle!"

Wang Shuo was a little unsure.

Can he beat Rag?

Moreover, in terms of high-end combat power, Dahuai Domain is at an absolute disadvantage.

There is only one junior general, Ayub, and there is no intermediate general.

It has been several months since Zhao Bangde and his team entered the Three Stars Secret Realm.

Wang Shuo's only hope at present is that they can return quickly.

In the Three Stars Secret Realm, Zhao Bangde and his team are attacking the last boss.

After killing this boss with a human head and a snake body, they can completely control this secret realm.

In the past few months, they don't know how many bosses they have killed.

In this secret realm, there is something like a hot spring, which can greatly increase their cultivation speed, and more importantly, it can increase their chances of breaking through the bottleneck.

It is with the help of this hot spring that Zhao Bangde and his team have basically upgraded one level.

Gong Zheng, who had accumulated a lot of experience, was promoted twice and reached the level of a senior general.

It was because of a fool like Gong Zheng that they could kill so many powerful bosses and get the resources for cultivation.

On the Great Wall outside the Dahuai Domain, the horn of war had already sounded.

Wang Shuo jumped off the wall directly.

Killing monsters and accumulating anger.

In the eyes of the soldiers defending the city, this was no different from a single person fighting against the army of monsters, full of sadness.

Wang Shuo held a spear and stood proudly, which was infinitely elongated in everyone's mind.

The army of monsters came.

The soldiers of the Dahuai Domain were united and fought against the attack of the monsters.

The Great Wall could not ban airspace.

The flying monsters were the first wave to launch an attack.

But what greeted them were countless bronze spears.

After a long period of development, the bronze crossbow technology of the Dahuai Domain has become very mature.

There are already tens of thousands of bronze crossbows in the entire Dahuai Domain.

The number of catapults was also considerable, with more than 8,000. In one round of volleys, 8,000 shells fell on the monster army, causing great casualties.

At the same time, there were countless arrow towers and energy towers standing on the Great Wall.

The firepower on the Great Wall was still very fierce.

If it were only low-level monsters, no matter how many came, they would not be able to rush through.

But in the monster army, there were hundreds of platinum-level bosses whose combat power was comparable to that of junior generals.

There were also dozens of diamond-level bosses.

There were even two star-level bosses, one was the supreme commander Rag, and the other was Jamie.

For the Dahuai domain, which lacked high-end combat power, this defect was fatal.
